battle.name: 第二次意大利獨立戰爭
battle.theater: 倫巴第平原與米蘭西北戰線
battle.brief: 一八五九年四月末，薩丁尼亞王國議會批准與法國結盟，奧軍五月二十九日進攻皮埃蒙特，戰火在倫巴第平原鋪開。卡面線膛砲代表一八五八年前後剛問世的線膛前膛野戰砲，射程遠超滑膛銅砲，砲兵頭一次能在射程上壓過步兵；索爾費里諾一役雙方主力仍是滑膛砲，線膛砲要到一八六〇年代才全面取代它。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 交戰雙方是法國第二帝國與薩丁尼亞王國的聯軍，對上奧地利帝國與德意志邦聯諸邦的聯軍。聯軍一方的法軍由拿破崙三世以御前統帥身分直接指揮，編成阿爾卑斯軍：步兵分編為多個師，每師轄數旅，每旅再分為營，每營在戰時都配屬一門六磅砲，另有旅屬砲與師屬砲，砲兵總數逾百門，工兵與攻城器材由元帥紐爾統籌，騎兵另由獨立騎兵旅分領。薩丁尼亞方面，國王維克多·埃馬努埃萊二世任全軍最高指揮，卡富爾以首相兼軍政總監坐鎮後方，前線由拉·馬爾莫拉、凡蒂與祖基分率第一、第二、第三軍，另有阿爾卑斯獵手營、邊防民兵與志願者。奧軍方面由弗朗茨·約瑟夫御前統帥，實際指揮先後為居伊萊侯爵與本代克，軍隊按六個軍編制，步兵以營為基本單位，團級炮隊與騎兵團編入各軍；德意志邦聯條款使巴登、符騰堡、薩克森等邦的分遣隊與炮兵營隨奧軍作戰，匈牙利與克羅地亞各團也在奧軍序列之中。英國與俄羅斯宣布中立，使法國得以單獨承擔主要風險。
countriesEn: The two sides were the allied army of France and the Kingdom of Sardinia on one hand, and the Austrian Empire together with contingents of the German Confederation states on the other. On the allied side the French Army of the Alps was commanded by Napoleon III in person as commander-in-chief. Its infantry was organised into divisions, each division into brigades and each brigade into battalions, and in time of war every battalion drew a six-pounder, with additional brigade and divisional guns on top; the artillery park numbered more than a hundred pieces, the engineers and the siege train were handled by Marshal Niel, and the cavalry was formed into independent cavalry brigades. On the Sardinian side King Victor Emmanuel II was the supreme commander, with Cavour as prime minister and war minister holding the rear; in the line stood the first, second and third corps under La Marmora, Fanti and Zucchi, together with the Cacciatori delle Alpi, the frontier militia and volunteers. The Austrian army was nominally under Franz Joseph, with actual command exercised in turn by Count Gyulai and by Benedek, and organised into six armies; the infantry worked at battalion level, regimental batteries and cavalry regiments were attached to each army; German Confederation contingents and batteries from Baden, Württemberg and Saxony served with the Austrians under the terms of the Confederation, and Hungarian and Croatian regiments fought in the Austrian ranks. Britain and Russia declared themselves neutral, which left France free to carry the main risk alone.
people: 卡富爾是整場戰爭的策劃者。他在普隆比耶爾與拿破崙三世密談，訂下以法國軍力對付奧地利、由薩丁尼亞承擔主戰場與法軍輔助的分工；一八五九年四月他說服國王召開議會，以近乎全票通過與法國結盟並開戰的決議。拿破崙三世御駕親征，馬真塔與索爾費里諾兩役都由他指揮，但他在勝利之後選擇停戰，成為日後輿論非議的焦點；其麾下以元帥紐爾主持工兵與攻城最為出色，率第五師的馬康在中路突破，第九師的瓦揚在馬真塔的側翼攻擊中扮演關鍵角色，參謀長與諸元帥則在停戰與否的抉擇上影響了他的判斷。薩丁尼亞方面，國王維克多·埃馬努埃萊二世以總司令身分在前線，與拉·馬爾莫拉、凡蒂、祖基等將領合作，帕萊斯特羅的指揮者是庫爾邦；拉莫雷爾在索爾費里諾重傷不治，其師隨即交由別人接手。奧地利方面，弗朗茨·約瑟夫在會見本代克後解除了他的指揮權，居伊萊在停戰前夕被撤換；一八四九年鎮壓匈牙利革命而惡名昭彰的海瑙此時被調到義大利戰線，主持後方與預備隊的事務。流亡海外的匈籍將領克拉普卡率領匈牙利兵團投入法軍陣營。
peopleEn: Cavour was the planner of the whole war. At Plombières he spoke with Napoleon III and fixed the division of labour: France would defeat Austria with its armies while Sardinia fought the main battle in the theatre and the French supported; in April 1859 he persuaded the king to summon the parliament, which approved the alliance with France and the declaration of war by an almost unanimous vote. Napoleon III came to Italy in person and commanded at both Magenta and Solferino, but after the victory he chose to stop, which became the focus of later criticism. Of the men around him Marshal Niel, who directed the engineers and the siege train, made the most visible mark; MacMahon, commanding the fifth division, broke through in the centre, and Vaillant's ninth division played the decisive part in the flanking attack at Magenta, while the chief of staff and the marshals around the emperor influenced his judgement on the armistice. On the Sardinian side Victor Emmanuel II was commander-in-chief in the line, working with La Marmora, Fanti and Zucchi, and Courbon commanded at Palestro. Lamoricière was mortally wounded at Solferino and his division passed to other hands. On the Austrian side Franz Joseph relieved Benedek of his command after their meeting, and Gyulai was replaced on the eve of the armistice; Haynau, notorious for the suppression of the Hungarian revolution in 1849, had been brought to the Italian theatre to run the rear and the reserve. The Hungarian exile Klapka led the Hungarian legion in French service.
kits: 卡面這件線膛砲代表一八五〇年代後期才成熟的前膛線膛野戰砲：膛線使同樣藥量的火藥把彈丸送出更遠，再用長形炮彈配合銅製彈帶封住氣密，射程因此遠超傳統滑膛銅砲。德意系銅砲傳統以不倫瑞克等邦的兵工廠最有名，一八五八年前後德意志諸邦的工坊與奧地利軍械局都試製過線膛前膛野戰砲，英國有阿姆斯特朗砲、法國有帕羅砲，奧軍的試射則專門測試長形炮彈的效果。然而一八五九年真正投入戰場的線膛砲數量極少，交戰三軍的主力仍是滑膛銅砲：奧軍裝備四磅、六磅與十二磅滑膛砲，薩丁尼亞軍以四磅與六磅滑膛砲為主力，法軍則是四磅、六磅與十二磅。滑膛六磅砲的有效射程約六百至八百米、最大射程約一千二百米，線膛六磅砲可用全藥量發射長形彈，最大射程可達三千米以上，這個差距正是卡面那句話的來處：砲兵頭一次能在射程上壓過步兵。一八五九年兩軍仍以密集橫隊與線形射擊為主，掩體的價值尚未被完全認識；直到一八六〇年代線膛砲成軍、普法戰爭時後膛砲普及，稀疏散兵線與利用地形才成為標準打法。營屬六磅砲靠雙馬或四馬牽引，砲車與備用彈藥箱同車，一門砲連同附件重約一噸，連同火藥與備彈每日需多匹挽馬維持，長距離作戰的成敗往往取決於這支隊伍能否跟上步兵。
kitsEn: The muzzle-loading field gun on this card stands for the rifled muzzle-loader that only matured in the late 1850s: rifling sent the same charge of powder further, and a long projectile with a copper driving band sealed the bore, so that the range passed far beyond that of the traditional smoothbore bronze gun. The German bronze tradition was strongest in the foundries of Brunswick and its neighbours, and around 1858 the workshops of the German states and the Austrian ordnance bureau all produced rifled muzzle-loading field guns in trial batches, alongside Armstrong's gun in Britain and Parrot's in France, while Austrian proving trials were used to test the effect of the elongated projectile. The number actually in service in 1859, however, was very small, and the main armament of all three armies was still the smoothbore bronze gun. The Austrians used four-, six- and twelve-pounder smoothbores, the Sardinians relied mainly on four- and six-pounders, and the French had four-, six- and twelve-pounders. The effective range of a smoothbore six-pounder was about six hundred to eight hundred metres and its maximum range about twelve hundred, while a rifled six-pounder could fire its full charge of a long projectile beyond three thousand metres; that gap is exactly where the card's line comes from, that artillery could for the first time outrange the infantry. In 1859 both armies still fought in dense line and with massed volleys, and the value of cover was not yet fully understood. Only when rifled guns became standard in the 1860s and breechloaders spread in the Franco-Prussian War did the thin skirmish line and the use of ground become the normal way to fight. The battalion six-pounder was drawn by two or four horses, with the carriage and ready ammunition boxes carried on the same vehicle; a gun with its fittings weighed roughly a tonne, and a column of guns with powder and spare shot needed a good many more horses each day, so in a long operation the whole thing turned on whether that team could keep up with the infantry.
tactics: 三軍都沿用拿破崙時代的戰術骨架：行軍用縱隊，作戰展開為師級橫隊，營縱隊在前，旅屬砲與營屬砲在後方梯次展開，待步兵展開完畢才齊射。薩丁尼亞軍的戰役序列很清楚——五月底以帕萊斯特羅與蒙泰貝洛兩役先拔除奧軍在倫巴第的前哨，牽制其左翼，六月初主力自齊維塔與諾維卡拉逼近馬真塔。法軍的機動是本戰役最吃緊的一環：翻越阿爾卑斯山時主隊取尚貝尼山口，另一縱隊經小聖伯納山口，紐爾的工程兵在積雪中開闢道路，火炮與攻城器材由數百匹馬拖過山脊，因此法軍主力直到五月下旬才完成部署。馬真塔一役的勝負靠法軍第九師在北面的側翼迂迴，砲兵先以集中火力壓制鐵路車站一帶的奧軍陣地，再由步兵發動突擊；索爾費里諾則是法軍左翼與薩軍左翼同時發動的雙翼攻擊，法軍第五師在聖安德烈攻擊奧軍右翼，薩軍阿爾卑斯獵手由山區側翼下來切入。整場戰役的掩體運用仍很原始，多依村莊、灌溉渠、葡萄園與松林遮蔽；後方補給靠從熱那亞與里窩那經鐵路運到米蘭，再轉運至維爾切利，奧軍則自維羅納與曼圖亞方向補給，距離較長，一旦退向四方堡壘線便失去主動。
tacticsEn: All three armies worked from the Napoleonic skeleton of tactics: columns on the march, divisional lines in battle, with battalion columns in front and brigade and battalion guns deployed in echelon behind them, firing only after the infantry had completed its deployment. The Sardinian sequence of operations was clear: Palestro at the end of May and Montebello a few days later struck at the Austrian outposts in Lombardy and pinned the Austrian left, and at the beginning of June the main body pressed from Chivasso and Novara toward Magenta. The movement of the French army was the tightest part of the whole campaign: the main body crossed by the Mont Cenis and another column by the Little Saint Bernard, with Niel's engineers cutting roads through the snow and the guns and siege material dragged over the passes by several hundred horses, so the French did not complete their deployment until the latter half of May. The outcome at Magenta turned on the flanking movement of the ninth division in the north, the artillery first silencing the Austrian positions around the railway station with concentrated fire and the infantry then striking; Solferino was a double envelopment, the French fifth division attacking the Austrian right at Sant'Andrea while the Sardinian Cacciatori delle Alpi came down from the hills on the other flank. Cover was still used in a primitive way, relying on villages, irrigation ditches, vineyards and pine woods, and the rear was supplied over the railway from Genoa and Livorno to Milan and thence to Vercelli, while the Austrians drew their supplies from the direction of Verona and Mantua over a longer line; once they fell back behind the Quadrilateral fortresses they lost the initiative.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下：戰爭自一八五九年四月二十六日開打，到七月十一日維拉弗蘭卡的停戰條約，前後約七十五天；真正密集交戰集中在五月底至六月下旬，約一個月。兵力方面，法軍投入阿爾卑斯軍約七萬五千至八萬人，薩丁尼亞軍約六萬五千人，奧軍在倫巴第與威尼提亞的可用兵力初期約八萬至九萬人，戰役高峰可集結到十二萬人上下。索爾費里諾一役雙方合計約二十四萬人，是拿破崙戰爭以來歐洲規模最大的會戰，各方傷亡合計約四萬人；馬真塔一役法軍傷亡約六千至七千人，奧軍約一萬至一萬二千人；帕萊斯特羅與蒙泰貝洛兩役薩軍獲勝，奧軍傷亡以千計。砲兵方面，法軍野戰砲約一百四十門，薩軍約九十門，奧軍在戰線上可投入的野戰砲數十門，會戰時雙方合計野戰砲逾兩百門。時間上，兩週之內數度行軍跨越阿爾卑斯山；距離上，帕萊斯特羅距都靈約五十公里，馬真塔距米蘭約八十公里。此外，加里波第在拉普拉塔流域為義大利籌款並募得志願兵，雖然未能及於本戰役，卻預告了下一年南部進軍的人力來源。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The war was fought from 26 April 1859 to the armistice at Villafranca on 11 July, about seventy-five days in all, with the dense fighting concentrated between the end of May and the third week of June, roughly a month. In strength, the French Army of the Alps numbered about seventy-five to eighty thousand men, the Sardinian army about sixty-five thousand, and the Austrians had perhaps eighty to ninety thousand available in Lombardy and Venetia at the outset, rising to something like one hundred and twenty thousand at the height of the campaign. At Solferino the two sides together numbered about two hundred and forty thousand men, the largest battle in Europe since the Napoleonic wars, with casualties of roughly forty thousand; at Magenta the French lost about six to seven thousand and the Austrians about ten to twelve thousand; at Palestro and Montebello the Sardinians won, and Austrian losses ran into the thousands. In artillery, the French field battery park was around one hundred and forty guns and the Sardinians about ninety, the Austrians could bring several dozen field pieces into the line, and more than two hundred field guns were deployed in the course of the great battle. In time, the armies marched across the Alps within a fortnight; in distance, Palestro lies about fifty kilometres from Turin and Magenta about eighty from Milan. Garibaldi, meanwhile, was raising money and volunteers in the River Plate region for the Italian cause; he could not affect this campaign, but he foretold the source of men for the expedition of the following year.
cause: 起因有四層。最外一層是歐洲的外交格局：奧地利在義大利與德意志兩線同時維持大軍，卻在一八五九年的維也納會議上拒絕裁軍，讓其盟國與對手都懷疑它會先動手，而法國則需要一個能削弱奧地利又不至於失控的戰場。最內一層是義大利統一運動本身：一八四八年第一場獨立戰爭失敗後，奧地利重新控制倫巴第、威尼提亞與中部各省，帕爾馬、摩德納、托斯卡納與教宗國的改革派青年大批流亡海外，卡富爾的薩丁尼亞遂成為統一運動的合法國家載體，目標是以北義大利為基地，逐步收復威尼斯與中部。物質層面是薩丁尼亞一八五〇年代以來的財政、鐵路與軍制改革，加上卡富爾在普隆比耶爾談成的法薩同盟：法國承諾出兵，薩丁尼亞承諾不單獨媾和，並同意讓法國在戰後取得威尼斯作為交換。觸發點則直接而具體：一八五九年四月二十九日奧地利向薩丁尼亞發出最後通牒，要求三軍解除武裝並退出倫巴第，而薩丁尼亞議會此前已於四月二十六日批准開戰，於是奧軍越過提契諾河，戰爭由外交危機變成槍聲。英國與俄羅斯保持中立，是法國敢於單獨承擔這場戰爭的前提。
causeEn: The causes run in four layers. The outermost is the diplomatic map of Europe. Austria maintained large armies on two fronts at once, in Italy and in Germany, yet refused to disarm at the Vienna Conference of 1859, so that both its allies and its rivals suspected it would strike first; France in turn wanted a theatre in which Austria could be weakened without the war running out of control. The innermost layer is the Italian unification movement itself. After the first war of Italian independence failed in 1848, Austria reasserted its hold over Lombardy, Venetia and the central provinces, the reformist young men of Parma, Modena, Tuscany and the Papal States fled abroad in thousands, and Cavour's Sardinia became the lawful carrier of the movement, with the aim of making northern Italy the base from which to recover Venetia and the centre. At the material level lay the fiscal, railway and military reforms of 1850s Sardinia, and on top of them the Franco-Sardinian alliance negotiated at Plombières: France promised troops, Sardinia promised not to make peace alone, and both accepted that France would receive Venetia after the war. The trigger was concrete and immediate. On 29 April 1859 Austria sent Sardinia an ultimatum demanding the disarmament of three armies and the evacuation of Lombardy; the Sardinian parliament had already approved the war on 26 April, and the Austrian army crossed the Ticino, turning a diplomatic crisis into gunfire. British and Russian neutrality was the precondition for France to dare to carry the war largely on its own.
impact: 影響橫跨軍事、外交與國家建構三個層面。軍事上，這是歐洲最後一場以滑膛銅砲為主要野戰火力的大戰，線膛砲在索爾費里諾之後迅速普及，一八六〇年代阿姆斯特朗與帕羅式線膛砲成軍，到普法戰爭時後膛砲已完全取代滑膛；砲兵射程倍增的直接後果是密集橫隊與胸前射擊的死亡，稀疏散兵線、利用掩體與側翼包抄成為標準，本戰役末尾已能見到這種轉變的雛形。外交上，法國以國家信用替一個次大國打仗而未取得任何領土，開了「為民族自由而戰、外交決定代價」的先例，其後俾斯麥在南德、波蘭與德意志統一問題上所用的正是同一套公式，而拿破崙三世本人則因這場戰爭得到的是停戰而非戰利品，名望不升反降。國家層面上，倫巴第歸薩丁尼亞，統一事業分裂為卡富爾的溫和外交路線與馬志尼、加里波第的激進路線，一八六〇年「千人遠征」以武裝起義拿下南部，一八六一年意大利王國成立，而威尼提亞仍留在奧地利手中，這道未竟的缺口讓義大利與奧地利在十年後的戰爭裡再續前緣；法國在克里米亞戰爭中支持奧地利，令意大利統一運動暫時受挫的同時，也把奧匈帝國的未來走向推到了歐洲外交的桌面。
impactEn: The consequences ran across three levels, military, diplomatic and constitutional. Militarily this was the last great war in Europe fought with smoothbore bronze guns as the principal field armament; rifled guns spread rapidly after Solferino, the Armstrong and Parrot patterns were fielded in the 1860s, and by the Franco-Prussian War breechloaders had entirely displaced the smoothbore. The direct consequence of the doubled reach of the guns was the death of the dense line and of fire at the breast; the thin skirmish line, the use of cover and the flanking envelopment became the standard, and the beginnings of that change can already be seen at the end of this campaign. Diplomatically France fought a war on another state's behalf, spent its own credit, and took no territory, opening the precedent of war for national freedom with the diplomatic bill settled by negotiation, a formula the Bismarck of the later 1860s used in the southern German question and in the Polish and German national questions; Napoleon III himself got an armistice rather than the spoils of victory, and his standing fell rather than rose. At the level of the state, Lombardy passed to Sardinia and the unification cause split between Cavour's moderate diplomatic line and the radical line of Mazzini and Garibaldi; the Expedition of the Thousand took the south by armed revolt in 1860, the Kingdom of Italy was proclaimed in 1861, and Venetia stayed in Austrian hands. That unfinished gap set Italy and Austria on a collision course ten years later: France's support for Austria in the Crimean War set the Italian movement back for a time, but it also pushed the future shape of the Austro-Hungarian Empire onto the table of European diplomacy.

resultEn: The result was that France won the campaign and lost the diplomacy. Palestro and Montebello were won by the Sardinians; at Magenta the French broke the Austrian left with a flanking attack and the line of advance turned toward Milan; on 23 June at Solferino the Franco-Sardinian double envelopment destroyed the Austrian right, and Napoleon III was victorious on the field. But the price of that victory appeared at once. The French had chased the Austrians for days and were exhausted, short of ammunition and short of food, and pushing further west would have run them into the Austrian Quadrilateral fortresses; Napoleon III chose the armistice rather than the destruction of the enemy. On 6 July he met Franz Joseph at Villabrégua, and on 11 July the main terms were settled at Villafranca: Austria ceded Lombardy to Sardinia, Venetia was left for later, and France got nothing. Benedek's obstinate refusal at Villafranca became one of the best known episodes in later military history. The Treaty of Zurich, signed on 10 November, confirmed the arrangement, and the Austrian main body withdrew behind the fortresses. Politically Cavour resigned in October because he opposed the terms of the armistice, the unification movement split, and the mainline and moderate parties went their separate ways. The real closure came in 1866, when in the third Italian war of independence Italy fought alongside Prussia and Venetia and Friuli were joined to the kingdom.
